problem: AanZET blog merged while a non-required technical SEO workflow had already found a title-length violation and missing functional figures.
root_cause: The blog technical SEO workflow was informative rather than merge-blocking for this lineage, so auto-merge could complete before that quality defect was repaired.
prevention: Treat Blog Technical SEO Gate failure as an immediate recovery obligation even when branch protection does not require it.
For new blog artifacts keep title <= 60 characters and include at least two functional figures with accessible SVG semantics.
Do not claim the content terminally live until the recovery candidate is merged and exact-main production readback succeeds.

invariants: same canonical URL and content lineage
